Usage: yantra list [options] [target]

List saved workflows or recent runs

Arguments:
  target             workflows | runs (default: "runs")

Options:
  --limit <n>        maximum number of entries to show (default: "20")
  --workflow <name>  filter runs by workflow name
  --status <s>       filter runs by status
                     (running|completed|failed|aborted|paused)
  --json             emit JSON instead of a terminal table (default: false)
  --debug            verbose logging on stderr (default: false)
  -h, --help         display help for command
